delivery.title: Delivery Detail - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: A "Pass" yah only mean seh di target server return an HTTP 2xx status - it no confirm seh di receiving system actually store or process di lead. Check di response body above fi weh it actually seh; if it blank or jus an acknowledgement, dat system may be a receive di request but a reject or ignore di payload internally (wrong field names/format fi it API , a required field pan it side weh dis payload nuh include, etc).

push.title: Outbound Webhooks - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Fully customizable per webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), or yuh own Custom body template wid <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (eg <example></example> ) - works like filling in a cURL command once.
push.curlHelp: Paste di example request weh dem API docs or Postman gi yuh (wid real or sample data). Di URL , method an headers dem copy as-is, an every key inna di body list dong ya so yuh can choose which CRM field fill it fi each lead.
push.curlPrompt: Yuh have di client's cURL ? <action>Import fram cURL</action> fi fill dis in an map fields automatically.
push.urlVariables: Di URL can contain variables too, eg <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Headers haffi be valid JSON , eg {{example}}
push.authTitle: Authentication (how Leadrat sign in to dem API )
push.modeSame: Sen every event to di same URL
push.modeCreateUpdate: Create di record once, den update dat deh same record (no duplicates pan dem side)
push.responseIdRequired: Dem record ID inna di response *
push.responseIdOptional: Dem record ID inna di response (optional)
push.responseIdHint: Weh di ID deh inna dem JSON reply to di create request. Saved per lead as <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Fi timeouts, HTTP 429 an 5xx errors - afta 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: How values ​​get filled in: dis webhook is reused fi every lead - Leadrat nuh send a static example, it send a fresh push each time a selected event happen, wid THAT lead's current values.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Form automatically include every field pan di lead - nutten fi set up.
push.howFilledCustom: Custom - write yuh own request body an drop in anywhere; each one get swap fi dat deh lead's real value right before sending. Click a variable dung ya fi insert it.
push.rawTemplate: Body Template (raw) - edit directly or insert variables
push.preview: Preview - weh ago actually sen (sample lead)
push.previewEmpty: (write a body template above fi see a preview)
push.deleteConfirm: Delete webhook " {{name}} "? Dis cyaan be undone.
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync push di fos {{total}} a {{count}} lead (limit {{limit}} per run). Narrow di date range fi push di rest.
push.resyncTruncated_other: Resync push di fos {{total}} a {{count}} leads (limit {{limit}} per run). Narrow di date range fi push di rest.
push.syncHelp: Push every lead registered inna dis date range again (leave both blank fi push everyting).

receive.title: Receive - Accept Leads in Any Format
receive.intro: Each source get it own URL . Point Facebook lead ads, Zapier , a website form or another CRM 's webhook at it - dem send leads inna dem own JSON or form format, an yuh map dem fields to yours.
receive.urlIntro: Yuh receive URL - gi dis to di sending system ( POST , JSON or form-encoded):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Generate a new URL ? Di uol wan stap wok siem taim.
receive.sendExample: Sen one example fos - it is captured as a sample (nothing is imported until di mapping below is saved).
receive.securityAuthTitle: Only accept requests weh sign wid dis secret

pull.title: Pull - Fetch Leads fram Any API
pull.intro: Leadrat call anodda system's API pan a schedule (any auth, any paging) an import di records dem weh it return. Records it have see before update di same lead.
pull.variables: Variables: <since></since> (last successful run, ISO time; empty di first time), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Save, den Fetch sample - Leadrat call di API once (first page only) an import notn.

api.title: Yuh API - Two-Way Access fi Any System
api.intro: Any system wid yuh API key can create, read an update leads an subscribe to lead events. Sen di key inna di <hdr></hdr> header, as <bearer></bearer> , or (if di tool can't set headers) as <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} requests per minute.
api.noPermission: Only sombady wid di Manage Settings permission can view di API key.
api.shownOnce: Copy dis key now an store it somweh safe - fi security it only show once. If it lost, mek a new one.
api.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new API key? Di current key stop work immediately fi every system weh a use it.
api.openApiHint: Import di OpenAPI spec inna Postman , Zapier , Make or n8n fi get every endpoint ready fi use.
